# 2. Comparative Single-Cell & Meta-Analysis Pipeline
## 2.1 Pairwise Differential Expression (one_on_one)
```{r, "getting outputlists for each of the neuro immunulogical conditions.",eval=FALSE}

options(future.globals.maxSize = 1600 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)  # 160 GB

for (current_seu_patient in patient_list)
{
  seu_patient <- current_seu_patient$seu
    output_list <- list()

  
  for (seu in healthy_list) {
    
    seu_control <- seu$seu
  
  # Run one-on-one function and get output
  output <- one_on_one(seu_patient, seu_control, patient_type=current_seu_patient$condition, control_type="Healthy", patient_orig_ident=current_seu_patient$dataset)
  
  
# browser()
 
  # Extract orig.ident value
  orig_ident_value <- as.character(unique(seu$seu$orig.ident)[1])

  # Check if the orig.ident value already exists in output_list
  if (length(output_list) > 0 && orig_ident_value %in% names(output_list)) {
  # list is non-empty and that name already exists → append
  output_list[[orig_ident_value]] <- 
    append(output_list[[orig_ident_value]],
           output[[orig_ident_value]])
  } else {
  # either the list is empty, or that name isn't there yet → create it
  output_list[[orig_ident_value]] <- output[[orig_ident_value]]
  }

  }
  
output_dir <- paste0("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/",current_seu_patient$condition,"_",current_seu_patient$dataset,"_",current_seu_patient$sample,"_outputlist.qs")

                       
qsave(output_list,output_dir)
print(paste("just finished",output_dir))
gc()
    
}


```

#Subset to healthy controls only
{

                                                       "HC-4",

  #Kang
  seu_kang <- qread("/bigdata/barakgutman/neuroimmunulogical_project/scRNA-seq/scRNA_PBMCs/data/MS_and_other_disorders/Kang/seu_kang.qs")
  
  seu_kang <- subset(seu_kang, subset = sample  %in% c("JSB",

  #Ramesh

  seu_ramesh <- subset(seu_ramesh, subset = sample  %in% c("2",

  seu_cd59 <- subset(seu_cd59, subset = condition  == "Healthy")
  
  seu_cd59$sample <-"CD59-control"

# get_CD8_cells and get_full_seurat
{
  plan(multisession, workers = 8)         # or multicore on Linux console
  options(future.globals.maxSize = 100 * 1024^3) # 100 GiB

  healthy_list <- lapply(healthy_list, get_CD4_cells)
  healthy_list <- lapply(healthy_list, get_CD8_cells)
  healthy_list <- lapply(healthy_list, function(seu) {
    subset(seu, subset = is_CD8_T_cell == "CD8+ T cells")
  })
  healthy_list <- lapply(healthy_list, get_full_seurat)
  
  
  
}
